rules.initial_inclusion: Same party, text-length, primary-result and candidate-year rules as prep_bio_party.py
links: normalized full name across all states and districts
rules.normalization: Unicode NFKC, casefold and collapsed whitespace; names retain only alphanumeric characters
rules.representative: Earliest election year; ties use original source-row order
rules.identity_limit: Recorded links are not an externally verified person registry. Name matches can conservatively merge different people; unknown aliases without shared identifiers may remain.
